links.outcome: Readability and complexity of LLM answers for patients (Flesch reading ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level)
links.effect: ChatGPT-4.0 answers were more complex for patients than those of Gemini and Copilot, though rated reliable and accurate; 92% of its answers were rated agree/strongly agree.
links.quote: Although the answers of ChatGPT-4.0 to questions about keratoconus were more complex for patients than those of other language programs, the information provided was reliable and accurate.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4.0, Google Gemini, Copilot) responding to patient questions about keratoconus, evaluated for readability and accuracy by clinicians without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
